name: Gigantspinosaurus
isnote: Treated as a valid stegosaur by Maidment and Wei 2006 and redescribed by Hao et al. 2018; its position inside Stegosauria is not resolved in the sources used.
sum: Gigantspinosaurus is a stegosaur from the Late Jurassic of Sichuan, China, known for its very large shoulder spines.
wsnote: Maximum length given in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: ZDM 0019, a partial skeleton of a probably subadult individual without the skull — Upper Shaximiao Formation, Zigong, Sichuan.
biology: Only the armour and skeletal anatomy are discussed in the sources; diet and behaviour are not documented beyond its stegosaurian affinities.
author: Ouyang 1992

sources.text: Ouyang, H. 1992. Discovery of ''Gigantspinosaurus sichanensis'' and its scapular spine orientation. Abstracts and Summaries for Youth Academic Symposium on New Discoveries and Ideas in Stratigraphic Paleontology: 47–49.
